# Security

Please report website or repository security issues privately by emailing
[rui@ruimarques.xyz](mailto:rui@ruimarques.xyz). Do not open a public issue for
an unaddressed vulnerability.

The OpenPGP key and current reporting metadata are published at
[ruimarques.xyz/.well-known/security.txt](https://ruimarques.xyz/.well-known/security.txt).
